summary: Mail subjects are consistent and Discovery no longer repeats the same mails.

fixes.title: Mail subjects in one format
fixes.text: Every mail subject reads environment, severity, what happened and PIM Manager, so you can sort and filter mails easily.

fixes.title: No repeated Discovery mails
fixes.text: Discovery remembers what it has already reported, so the same item is not mailed again.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The data-quality check compares like with like, and the licence request is more robust.
